hypothesis: Separating a held visual reference from the moving hand and observer camera allows an independently aimed free wrist view without moving or releasing the load.
comparison: B20 matched-prefix diagnostic only. Same frozen model and sensor grasp thresholds; free-observer interface, explicit camera metrics, motion account and visible-depth veto are new. Full-start run is not comparable to warm-start results.

static_neural_gate.required: Exact saved image hashes and feasible scoped action selection; manually review chosen camera/reference/motion relation, no claim of observed new affordance.

gate_each.new_check: 8deg free-left-wrist roll and inverse; fresh measured depth veto at execution

full_start_pilot.start_after: Exact-source gates pass; matched diagnostic has no new control/sensor safety regression; inspect actual initial images
full_start_pilot.success: Official full task criterion only with complete trace/video, no expert action warm start

stop_conditions: Current RGB-D, FK, command mapping or grip invariant violation
No offered safe action, measured inspection motion/attempt bound
Disk reserve below 80GiB or new artifacts above 4GiB
limitations: Depth-box veto is negative-only and sampled, not complete environment/held-object or unobserved-space collision certification
Camera pointing improvement is not a changed visible object side
Historical surface anchor is not current button detection or identity proof
Known development instance; never call single-instance SR generalization
All attempted full-start episodes and failures remain in denominator; diagnostics and gates separately counted
